title: Relative logarithmic differential module at a geometric point
statement: Let $f:(X,M)\to(Y,N)$ be a morphism of locally Noetherian fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], and let $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ be a geometric point with $\Omega$ algebraically closed. Put $A=\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}$ and $L=M_{\bar x}$, using the pointed-etale-neighbourhood colimits [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Define the relative logarithmic differential module $\omega_{f,\bar x}$ as the quotient of the free $A$-module on symbols $da$ ($a\in A$) and $d\log m$ ($m\in L$) by the $A$-span of $d(a+b)-da-db$, $d(ab)-a\,db-b\,da$, $d\log(mm')-d\log m-d\log m'$, $d\alpha(m)-\alpha(m)d\log m$, and the base ring and base log symbols. Explicitly the base relations are $d(\operatorname{germ}_v(k^\sharp c))=0$ and $d\log(\operatorname{germ}_v(f^\flat b))=0$ for every etale $W\to Y$, etale $V\to X$, lift $v$ of $\bar x$ to $V$, morphism $k:V\to W$ over $f$, $c\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$ and $b\in N(W)$. Equivalently they kill the images of all elements of $\mathcal O_{Y,f(\bar x)}$ and $N_{f(\bar x)}$. The symbols in the quotient define the ordinary and logarithmic differential functions. For a global chart $\beta:Q\to N(Y)$, its source log-stalk map is the composite $Q\to N(Y)\xrightarrow{f^\flat}M(X)\to M_{\bar x}$, with the last arrow the canonical geometric germ.
